scenario.title: The scarf delivery that moved
scenario.setting: A boutique owner at Silk & Stone Apparel whose assistant recalls which wholesalers promised which delivery windows

items.text: Silk & Stone Apparel is a boutique on Fellworth Lane; it is open Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00.
Priya is the floor manager and handles day-to-day supplier calls when Amara is off.
We only place reorders with wholesalers that have given us a confirmed delivery window in writing or by call.
Any supplier invoice over 500 pounds needs Amara's signature before payment.
The shop window is refreshed before every season launch so the display is up at least a week before the launch event.
Northline Textiles is our main scarf wholesaler; their rep is Colin and he confirms delivery windows by phone.
Last winter's scarf launch sold 320 scarves at 28 pounds each in four weeks.
This year's holiday window theme is 'Alpine Frost', white and silver with the new scarves as the centrepiece.
Lindon Fabric Co quoted 250 merino beanies at 5.40 pounds each, delivered to the shop by 15 September.
Ordered 250 merino beanies from Lindon Fabric Co for the autumn season.
Northline Textiles promised a delivery window of 20 to 27 November for the winter scarf reorder, at 7.50 pounds per scarf.
Order 400 winter scarves from Northline Textiles this season, up from 320 last year.
The winter scarf launch event will be Saturday 28 November at the shop, with evening drinks from 18:30.
The marketing email announcing the scarf line goes out on 16 November, ahead of the delivery.
Confirm the 400-scarf reorder with Northline Textiles and book the delivery date with Colin, no later than Friday 6 November. Not done yet.
Decorator Marcus will install the Alpine Frost window display on Thursday 19 November.
Run a 15 percent preview discount for mailing-list customers on the beanies through October.
Meridian Wool Supplies quoted 300 lambswool scarves at 6.20 pounds each, delivered by 1 December.
Pay the Lindon Fabric Co beanie invoice (1,350 pounds). Done on 24 September.
Lindon Fabric Co delivered the 250 beanies on 14 September, all in good condition.
Book Marcus for the window installation. Done on 6 October for Thursday 19 November.
Priya is on holiday from 12 to 25 October; Amara covers the shop alone in that stretch.
The beanie preview discount sold 90 beanies in October.
The shop's Christmas gift-wrapping station will be set up in the back corner from 1 December.
